decision.reason: BTHaber original article read; cloud overspend due to overprovisioning, contract commitments and lock-in yields a reviewable procurement workflow.

opportunities.core_job: Document financial and exit risks of cloud capacity and long-term commitments before contract approval
opportunities.target_customer: Turkish SME IT leads, cloud resellers and procurement officers
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-entered workloads, resource overprovisioning, contract terms, reservation length, budget and exit rights; what-if scenario and accountable approval report without cloud billing APIs
opportunities.why_now: BTHaber 13 October details cloud spend inflation caused by excess allocated resources, lengthy commitments and technology lock-in.
opportunities.before_state: Cloud budgets approved by monthly bill without decision trail for reserved capacity and lock-in.
opportunities.after_state: Cost and exit decision matrix with alternatives, human signoff and auditable evidence.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Manual datasets and browser-only deterministic calculations; competition and cost claims not final
